_comment: [AI] What studying a grammar guide takes (design 7.4). `full`, `pages` and `items`: the points that fill an empty guide, what a page is worth by its word's rarity, and what a survey report is worth, set so that a player finishes the guide after the desk's first upgrade and before its second (Jonah, 2026-11-22).

[AI] `trades`: what a full guide asks to study one new word of a tier, from the pages of a notebook in its slot. `price` pages of `paid_in` or a higher tier are spent, the lowest first, and the study runs `seconds` while the guide's chunk is loaded. The word is one the reader has not learned from `buckets`; a reader who knows them all is given `experience` points instead, as coal, lapis and diamond ore give. A page's tier is the one whose buckets hold its word's (Jonah, 2026-11-22).
